book.golemcraft.page1.title: GOLEMCRAFT
book.golemcraft.page1.subtitle: Official Game Manual
book.golemcraft.page1.content:
Welcome to the official GolemCraft guide!

Browse sections using the tabs or arrows:

• Basics: Creation (Iron Block + Pumpkin), oxidation and charge
• Roles: 7 unique professions
• Beacon: Pyramids and powers
• Recipes: Crafting table recipes
• Reset: Role reset using the Brush
book.golemcraft.page2.title: The Base Golem
book.golemcraft.page2.subtitle: Loyal and versatile helper
book.golemcraft.page2.content:
How to create:
Place 1 Iron Block and put a Carved Pumpkin on top, or use the Base Golem item on the ground.

Inventory (27 slots):
Press Shift + Right-Click to open its internal storage.

The Base Golem recognizes its master, will never hurt allies, and assists with your daily tasks.
book.golemcraft.page3.title: Oxidation & Wax
book.golemcraft.page3.subtitle: Metal care & maintenance
book.golemcraft.page3.content:
The Base Golem oxidizes in air through 4 stages:
1. Clean (fast and shiny)
2. Exposed (slight green patina)
3. Weathered (heavily oxidized)
4. Statue (frozen immobile)

Waxing: Click with Honeycomb to lock oxidation!
Scraping: Click with an Axe to scrape off patina or wax.
book.golemcraft.page4.title: Copper Statues
book.golemcraft.page4.subtitle: Freezing and restoration
book.golemcraft.page4.content:
At stage 4 oxidation, the golem freezes completely as a solid statue, immune to all attacks.

How to revive it:
Right-click with an Axe to scrape away the oxide layers and reactivate the golem!
book.golemcraft.page5_supercharge.title: Supercharged
book.golemcraft.page5_supercharge.conten:
The golem acts as a living lightning rod.

When struck by lightning or granted the Charge buff by the Beacon, it becomes Supercharged:
• Emits electric spark particles
• Greatly speeds up all its actions!
book.golemcraft.page5.title: Flower Golem
book.golemcraft.page5.subtitle: Flower harvester
book.golemcraft.page5.content:
Evolution:
Give any Flower to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
Gathers all nearby flowers and automatically deposits them into the nearest chest.
book.golemcraft.page6.title: Farmer Golem
book.golemcraft.page6.subtitle: Master harvester
book.golemcraft.page6.content:
Evolution:
Give a Hoe to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
Tills farmland, harvests mature crops, immediately replants seeds, and deposits all crops into the nearest chest.
book.golemcraft.page7.title: Lumberjack Golem
book.golemcraft.page7.subtitle: Forest caretaker
book.golemcraft.page7.content:
Evolution:
Give an Axe to a clean Base Golem.

Behavior:
Chops nearby trees, gathers logs, apples, and saplings, replants saplings, and deposits everything into the nearest chest.
book.golemcraft.page8.title: Fisherman Golem
book.golemcraft.page8.subtitle: River master
book.golemcraft.page8.content:
Evolution:
Give a Fishing Rod to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
Fishes in nearby water bodies and deposits caught fish and treasures into the nearest chest.
book.golemcraft.page9.title: Soldier Golem
book.golemcraft.page9.subtitle: Combat defender
book.golemcraft.page9.content:
Evolution:
Give a Sword, Bow, Crossbow, or Trident to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
Attacks hostile mobs on sight. You can choose to bring it along as a companion or leave it guarding a fixed post!
book.golemcraft.page10.title: Depth Golem
book.golemcraft.page10.subtitle: Sculk infused power
book.golemcraft.page10.content:
Evolution:
Give an Echo Shard to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
It is blind and cannot see, but senses sounds and fires sonic booms at enemies. You can bring it along or leave it guarding a post.
book.golemcraft.page11.title: Explorer Golem
book.golemcraft.page11.subtitle: Guide and drop retriever
book.golemcraft.page11.content:
Evolution:
Give a Recovery Compass to a Base Golem.

Behavior:
Acts as a constant light source (bring along or stay). If you die, it collects your drops and safely holds them in its inventory while waiting on site. Click with a vanilla Compass to get a Golem Compass!
book.golemcraft.page12.title: Golem Beacon
book.golemcraft.page12.subtitle: Pyramid structure
book.golemcraft.page12.content:
The Beacon empowers all golems in range.

Copper Pyramid:
Build a pyramid of copper blocks (1..4 tiers):
• Tier 1: 3x3 (9 blocks)
• Tier 2: 5x5 (+25 blocks)
• Tier 3: 7x7 (+49 blocks)
• Tier 4: 9x9 (+81 blocks)
book.golemcraft.page13.title: Beacon Powers
book.golemcraft.page13.subtitle: Buffs and upgrades
book.golemcraft.page13.content:
Insert a copper ingot into the Beacon GUI to select powers:

• Tier 1: Speed / Haste
• Tier 2: Resistance / Jump Boost
• Tier 3: Regeneration / Charge / Oxidation Immunity
• Tier 4: Secondary power or Level II buffs!
book.golemcraft.page14.title: Golem Beacon
book.golemcraft.page14.subtitle: Crafting table recipe
book.golemcraft.page14.content:
Crafting the Beacon:

Required materials:
• 5x Glass Blocks
• 1x Nether Star
• 3x Copper Blocks

Place atop the copper pyramid with clear sky above!
book.golemcraft.page15.title: Golem Manual
book.golemcraft.page15.subtitle: Shapeless recipe
book.golemcraft.page15.content:
Crafting the Manual:

Required materials:
• 1x Book
• 1x Copper Ingot

Shapeless recipe: place the two items anywhere in the grid to obtain the complete guide book.
book.golemcraft.page18.title: The Brush & Reset
book.golemcraft.page18.subtitle: Role reset
book.golemcraft.page18.content:
Role Reset:
Use a Brush on any specialized golem to clear its role and return it to a Base Golem!

Important Note:
Golems with a held tool will drop it on the ground; golems created with consumable items (flowers, echo shard, compass) will NOT refund the item.
